subject.title: fix: compaction usage guards and agent-loop turn correctness

question: What permanent plugin API should carry context-aware per-turn refreshes without creating two competing turn-preparation callbacks?
rationale: The implementation can be repaired mechanically, but choosing whether to extend the existing public hook, approve a parallel callback, or keep the composition internal defines a shipped plugin contract and requires owner intent.

options.title: Use one compatible hook
options.body: Evolve the existing turn-preparation contract through an owner-approved compatible shape and remove the parallel public callback before merge.

options.title: Approve the parallel callback
options.body: Keep `prepareNextTurnWithContext` as a distinct public API and document precedence, intended callers, compatibility expectations, and any future deprecation plan.

options.title: Split the API change
options.body: Land the independent correctness repairs after fixing their blockers and move the public callback decision into a separately reviewed change.

recommendation.title: Use one compatible hook
recommendation.body: Evolve the existing turn-preparation contract through an owner-approved compatible shape and remove the parallel public callback before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main history and this branch place the agent-core/session integration work with steipete, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the boundary decision.
